[SWS_CM_10471] E2E Error Handler - Invocation Arguments
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00401, RS_CM_00402
⌈
In case a new request message is available,
E2EErrorHandler
shall be
called with the following arguments:
errorCode
shall be set to the
ara::
com::e2e::ComE2EErrc
obtained in [SWS_CM_00038],
dataID
shall be set to
End2EndMethodProtectionProps
.
dataId
, and
messageCounter
shall be set to
the E2E counter of the received request message.
⌋
